turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Thanks for joining the DriveWealth Principal AI Engineer technical interview. We will talk through brokerage operations, KYC events, and how your agent architecture stays evidence grounded.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: First question. Design a small agent system that answers an operations analyst asking why a customer account is blocked. It may use account APIs, KYC status events, and curated policy evidence. Give me the graph, node responsibilities, state fields, edge conditions, and terminal outcomes.

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Second question. DriveWealth partner updates can arrive through SQS out of order. Your agent sees an older KYC approved event after a newer restricted event. How does it determine current state, preserve the conflicting evidence, and explain the result without inventing an event order?

turns.speaker: Interviewer
turns.text: Final question. If a CoderPad problem asks you to stream account events and produce an audit safe current status, what data structure and verification receipts would you use?
